newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TWO SOUTH AFRICAN PLAYERS LINKED WITH ENGLISH CLUBS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TWO SOUTH AFRICAN PLAYERS LINKED WITH ENGLISH CLUBS.

text.p: Natal rugby players Steve Atherton and Cabous van der Westhuizen have both been linked with offers to play for English second division club Richmond, a Durban newspaper reported on Tuesday.

Lock forward Atherton, who last played for South Africa in their Tri-Nations defeat by New Zealand in Cape Town ion August, confirmed he had been approached by both Richmond and last season's champions Bath, the Daily News said.
Wing van der Westhuizen, Natal's leading try-scorer of all time with 81, was believed to have attracted the interest of Richmond and as well as division one leaders Harlequins.
Natal Rugby Union chief executive Brian van Zyl confirmed on Tuesday that Atherton had flown to London.
"We don't know at this stage what Steve has been offered but we may not be able to match the offer," van Zyl said.
"This is a very real threat and, while English clubs may not be able to snap up all the country's leading players, we could have a situation where a number of top players go."
